request.description: The bridge is not a second public service

steps.detail: Frontend ingress is public; Front Door is not an enforced network-only entry point.
The website and bridge run in the same replica; the bridge listens only on loopback.
The bridge checks allowed origins and invokes the explicitly supplied agent with the app system identity.
